text:
Aisha R.: heads-up — customer `DeltaRetail` showing a steady weekly token usage drop (40% down MoM) and only 2 of 6 onboarding checkpoints completed. Renewal in 28 days. thinking we should codify a lightweight rescue ladder instead of a full heavy-touch play. thoughts?

Tom G.: can you paste the usage snapshot and main friction points? do we have recent NPS or support tickets?

Aisha R.: quick data — last 30d: active routes down 38%, avg tokens/session down 47%. top issues: long prompt latency spikes (1.2s -> 3.8s), failed webhook retries for ingestion, and unclear eval mismatch on routing prompts. recent support thread: https://support.internal/delta/12345 (notes about timeouts). NPS not collected since onboarding paused.

Jules M.: +1 on compact ladder. propose 3 tiers: 1) Auto-fix quick wins (config + cache tweaks), 2) Targeted enablement + 1:1, 3) Downgrade-safe path with feature flags + credits. keep timeline to 10 business days.

Priya S.: sounds good. for Tier 1 I can push a two-line config snippet to update their cache TTLs and enable prefix caching on their main route. will also check batching config.

Aisha R.: awesome. draft play (compact):
```
Tier 1 (0-3 days):
- Apply cache TTL 10s -> 60s, enable prefix kv cache
- Turn on small-batch mode for onboarding routes (batch_size: 8)
- Whitelist retry backoff on ingestion webhooks
- Outreach message: in-app nudge + one async guide

Tier 2 (3-7 days):
- 30-min enablement call: walkthrough quick wins, validate prompts
- Deploy canary with quantized model variant if cost spikes continue
- Add success metrics dashboard with these 3 probes: session tokens, p50 latency, webhook error rate

Tier 3 (7-10 days):
- Offer temporary feature-limited downgrade path (API keys with reduced concurrency + 20% credit)
- Create rollback/restore script for flags
- CSM handoff to renewal team if unresolved
```

Tom G.: quick Q — the quantized model can increase hallucination risk. run evals on their prompt set first?

Jules M.: yes, run a small eval harness (100 prompts) against the quantized candidate. I can spin that up. estimated 2-3h.

Priya S.: I pushed the cache change in staging, saw p50 latency drop ~350ms. will schedule enablement for Thu morning.

Aisha R.: sweet. I'll message the customer with the Tier 1 summary and a calendar link. @Tom G. can you run the eval by EOD? @Jules M. please prepare rollback snippet.

Tom G.: on it. planning to run eval with regen=1, temp=0.2, compare rouge/semantic similarity.

Jules M.: rollback snippet (for feature flags) attached: 
```
# rollback quick
flags.disable('delta_quiet_downgrade')
deploy -c canary=false
```

Priya S.: put the enablement invite on their calendar (DeltaRetail Onboarding — Thu 10am PT). also added the dashboard template to their org.

OpsBot: reminder set — follow-up check-in in 7 days for thread 3187654321.

Aisha R.: lovely. outcome goal = restore active routes to within 10% of baseline or move to downgraded seat with credit + clear rollback. thanks team :heart: 

Tom G.: noted — will update thread when eval completes.

Jules M.: will stage the canary and keep flags ready.

Priya S.: will run enablement and capture feedback notes in the playbook.

Aisha R.: tagging this as "rescue-ladder" in our playbook index. closing loop after the 7-day check. :raised_hands:
